skill.name: Unity project cache inventory
skill.description: Inventory Unity projects within the supplied roots and depth. Count only Library / Temp / obj / Logs, with disk distribution and selectable details. Empty or invalid input never expands the scan. Read-only; no files are deleted.
form.roots: Search roots (absolute paths; separate multiple paths with semicolons)
form.rootsHint: Example: D:\Projects;E:\UnityProjects · Empty or invalid input returns no results and never expands the scope.
form.safety: Count only Library / Temp / obj / Logs in each project; never count Assets, Packages, ProjectSettings or Build(s). Read-only; no files are deleted.
input.scopeFallback: No valid roots were supplied; using the explicitly supplied scope_path from the task panel.
input.maxRoots: At most {0} search roots are accepted; the rest were ignored.
input.relative: Skipped non-absolute path: {0} (enter an absolute path, such as D:\Projects).
input.depthDefault: depth is not a number; using the default depth of {0}.
input.depthMin: depth cannot be less than 1; using a depth of 1.
input.depthMax: depth is limited to {0}; using a depth of {0}.
log.noRoots: No valid search roots: nothing will be scanned, and the scope will not expand to all disks.
log.summary: Searched {0} roots and {1} directories; found {2} Unity projects with {3} of cache.
log.directoryLimit: Reached the directory search limit ({0}); results may be incomplete.
noRoots.title: Enter search roots in the task panel first
noRoots.help: Enter one or more absolute paths in roots, separated by semicolons, for example D:\Projects;E:\UnityProjects. No valid search roots were supplied, so nothing was scanned; the scope never expands to all disks.
noRoots.subtitle: No valid search roots; no scan was performed.
